Resource-background grafting and the correlated Poisson-operator boundary

1. A modular extension of the completed scalar-background construction

Suppose a background network on original species B1,...,Bk already has
an earned paired elementary compiler with a COMMON rational linear
resource W0. Assume its weights and inverse positive margins are paid,
its original-species weights gamma_j are positive with paid reciprocals,
and for the full instantaneous fault box
 L W0<=c0-kappa Q0,
where Q0 dominates every background2->2 source monomial. Bounded drift
and the exact unary/binary firing budget are enough; a uniform mean is
not required. The background structure/partition is fixed from R, not
from a numerical drift sign. No unseeded new resource is introduced.

Attach species A1,...,Al. Each extra non-null reverse pair has form
 q Ai+c <-> p Ai+c, p>q>=0, c_i=0,
and c contains AT LEAST ONE ORIGINAL background molecule. Other Aj may
occur in c, including cyclic dependencies. All context null/parallel
labels remain actual marks. Use private source prefixes ordered with
background molecules first, then the remaining context, then Ai. The
same hidden cross-uptake as in the completed scalar construction connects
the lower full prefix plus free Ai to the higher prefix carrying one
additional Ai, whenever the pre-existing first binding does not do so.
It is exactly balanced with raw ratio1/U between uptake and release.

Extend W0 to W by giving original Ai weight0, every attached auxiliary
weight resource(c_partial)=sum_j gamma_j*(its Bj payload), and retaining
the old background helper weights. Every attached transition preserves
W EXACTLY, including original-labelled conversions, cross-uptake,
partial bindings and releases. Thus L W<=c0-kappa Q0 remains pointwise
under full-history faults, even with sequestration of background atoms.
This uses the ACTUAL background weights of original Bj, not its unrelated
input omega or an unjustified additive weight on background helpers.

For each i construct Vi. Original Ai has weight1; other free Aj weight0;
background species have W0 weights. In an attached module changing Ai,
an incomplete-context prefix has its resource weight b_partial. A full
context plus j Ai has weight b+j(1-e), e=1/[2(D+1)], before terminal
adjustments. Here b=sum gamma_j*c_Bj>=gamma_min>0. The same3-state
